# apple_remove_beta_testers_from_app (Action)

Removes testers from every beta group and build of an app, without deleting them from other apps.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "apple_remove_beta_testers_from_app" "ann" {
  config {
    app_id          = data.apple_app.example.id
    beta_tester_ids = [apple_beta_group_tester.ann.beta_tester_id]
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.
- `beta_tester_ids` (Set of String) App Store Connect IDs of the beta testers.
